summary: I’m ready to pull the trigger on my filing, but when I do standard deduction of 31,500, my federal refund is +$65 and state is +$942. When I choose itemized deduction of $29,620, my federal refund is -$163 but my state refund is +$2,239. It seems like itemized is the better deal as I’d be over double the amount from my state refund as I would the combined federal + state for standard ...
